title: Tech Note: Tricks and Tips for Using the Form Wizard - Part 1

historical_commentary.text: This note teaches specific tricks for the 4D v6 Form Wizard (group boxes for organizing form objects, styling active objects, adding button text, and controlling output-form field widths) using the bundled MusicPro example; the Form Wizard itself and its options have been substantially redesigned in later 4D versions (and eventually joined by newer form design paradigms), making these exact UI steps superseded, though the underlying form-layout concepts (grouping, styling, field sizing) remain conceptually relevant.
related_updates: 4D's Form Wizard and overall form design tooling have been significantly redesigned across many subsequent 4D versions since v6
The MusicPro sample database referenced here is a period-specific 4D v6 bundled example, not necessarily present in current 4D installations
